clips.name: paris-crew
clips.description: Opening shot of the Paris cat-cafe day: six team members/guests in black event tees hold up the Chat-Rivari Cafe shirt to camera, smiling; f~25-40 the woman centre makes a heart with her hands and the camera pushes in; f45-53 motion blur as camera swings (good smear/whip exit).
clips.notes: LOGO RISK: the shirt print has a row of three round partner badges at its bottom edge (an exchange wordmark + a chain logo). Visible small on the left and centre shirts in f0-~30 (lower ~35% of frame, roughly y 430-560 of 720). Crop to the top ~60% (y<430) or blur/mask that band; f30+ the badges are mostly out of frame/blurred but still mask the bottom 25% to be safe.

clips.name: paris-cat-leap
clips.description: Real shelter tabby-and-white cat crouched on a wall shelf by the orange curtain, looks straight into camera then moves along the shelf (camera drifts right). Short 0.83 s natural shot - use as a hit/smash-cut or time-stretch.

clips.name: paris-cafe-sign
clips.description: Establishing shot: the white 'CHAT-RIVARI CAFE' cat-head decal with paw prints on the cafe window, camera trucks left-to-right revealing the full sign; Paris street/trees through glass. Great for a location title card or mask-reveal.
clips.notes: Clean. The cafe's own name only; no chain/exchange marks.

clips.name: paris-phones-play
clips.description: Guests at a cafe table playing on their phones (woman in navy polo foreground right holds phone, woman in cream shirt behind on phone), 'SCAN TO GET A PORTRAIT' poster and cat shelf in background; slow push-in. Reads as 'community playing the game'.
clips.notes: Phone screens are not legible. Foreground left shows the back of a Chat-Rivari tee (cat art only, badge row not visible). Clean.

clips.name: paris-chat
clips.description: Over-the-shoulder: young woman in black hoodie laughing and chatting with a guest, big wall clock and cat-themed decor behind. Warm, human beat.

clips.name: paris-cat-lounge
clips.description: Camera tilts up to a real shelter cat lounging on a padded shelf by the orange curtain; f20-32 the cat lifts its head and stares into the lens (ideal hero/end frame - hold or freeze f32).
clips.notes: HARD STOP: the source video's end card (Token Tails + exchange wordmark + 'Blockchain for Good Alliance' logos) is burned in from src 40.533 s; the extract ends at 40.50 s, so all 33 frames are clean. Never extend this clip past f32.

clips.name: ugc-king-portrait
clips.description: Creator UGC (9:16): woman in grey hoodie reveals a royal portrait of her tabby (crown, red-and-gold robe); f15-45 camera pushes into the painted cat's face; f60-89 she points at it, mock-shocked. Burned-in captions: 'I LOVE IT SO MUCH', 'OH MY GOD', 'SO JUDGMENTAL'.
clips.notes: Burned-in karaoke captions at lower third (y~1050-1110 of 1280). No chain/exchange marks. Source 24 fps resampled to 30 fps (frame duplication).

clips.name: ugc-kitten-recommend
clips.description: Creator UGC (9:16): tattooed bearded man in his car holding a grey kitten, lifts a printed portrait of his cats into frame. Captions: 'I RECOMMEND', 'TOKEN TAILS', 'REALISTIC PET PORTRAITS'.
clips.notes: Burned-in captions lower third. Clean. 24->30 fps.

clips.name: ugc-ceo-legends
clips.description: Creator UGC (9:16): man in grey blazer holding his grey British Shorthair in front of a regal two-cat portrait. Captions: 'THEM LOOK LIKE', 'THE LEGENDS THEY ARE', 'GET YOURS AT', 'TOKENTAILS.COM'.
clips.notes: Burned-in captions lower third. Clean. 24->30 fps. Content is about pet portraits rather than the heist; use as a fast community-wall tile.

clips.name: reel-game-night
clips.description: Packed room at a 'TOKEN TAILS GAME NIGHT': audience seated from behind (one backpack has a white cat face), presenter gesturing in front of a big projected slide with the Token Tails cat mascot. Handheld.
clips.notes: Square 360x360 source upscaled to 720x720 (soft - use small/in a tile, add grain). Slide has a tiny green partner logo top-left and a round badge bottom-right of the screen, illegible at this resolution; do not zoom into the screen.

clips.name: reel-tuxedo-characters
clips.description: Creator reel: real black-and-white tuxedo cat looking straight into camera, mouth slightly open. Caption: 'We're characters in the game Token Tails!' Real cat -> in-game character beat.
clips.notes: 360->720 upscale. Caption burned in lower area. Clean.

clips.name: reel-cat-plays-tablet
clips.description: Same creator: a black cat's paw taps a tablet showing the Token Tails game (pink floating-island PLAY screen, then the 'MY PETS' card grid); f~40-60 the paw swipes across the screen. Literal 'cats playing the game'.
clips.notes: 360->720 upscale. Tablet UI is the older Token Tails app, not Catnip Heist; no chain names visible.
